faq.q: What is a titanium headset spacer?
faq.a: A titanium headset spacer is a precision-machined headset hardware component used in micro-adjusting headset spacer 1/3/5mm. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium headset spacer?
faq.a: Titanium Headset Spacer is designed for micro-adjusting headset spacer 1/3/5mm. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium headset spacer manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Headset Spacer is manufactured using Hot forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium headset spacer?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
